ModMetaData.name: RIMMSqol
ModMetaData.author: Malte Schulze
ModMetaData.description:
Adds over 1000 editable properties for game objects. This allows modding the game through an UI while it is running. A keybinding(section "QOL") can be defined to edit what is under the cursor.
Ability to edit characters with configurable costs for upgrade/downgrades. Points can be earned through any of the tracked records and are configured in the mod menu.
Ability to group and change buttons in the main menu and architect categories.
Map search, improved pathfinder(must be turned on, only for 1.5-), editable custom storyteller, cities, UI customizations, food rules and more quality of life improvements. The full manual is found on steam.
Can be added/removed from ongoing save.
All features that change game code can be disabled in the mod menu's "General Settings" section under "Forbidden patches".
Performance Fish: Users must not activate the invoke reflection cache in PF's mod settings.
